noah: Originating RC: rc-2026-03-21c (tag rc-c21). Artifacts pushed: registry:redwood/inference:rc-c21, model=v2.4.4-rc1 (quant=q4f16-2026-03). Requesting ops pin, KV warm, and canary window 23:00-00:00 UTC.

kevin: CI smoke done in staging. Prepared rollback snippet and warm standby image. Rollback quick commands:
```
kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=redwood/inference:stable-2026-03-12 -n prod
deploy-bot rollback --id rc-c21 --reason "telemetry-anomaly"
```

maya: Model team confirms pin to q4f16-2026-03 and a fallback to q8 if OOMs hit. Latency in staging looks within SLA.

release-coordinator: Scheduled quiet window 23:00-00:00 UTC. Canary plan: 1% for 10m -> 10% for 20m -> 50% for 20m -> 100% if green. Added short release note draft link: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/rc-c21.md

deploy-bot: [CI] RC created: rc-2026-03-21c (build 821). Artifacts uploaded. Starting KV warm job id=kv-821.

deploy-bot: [kv-warm] warming ~800k keys, threads=6
[log] 30% complete...
[log] completed in 2m 10s, cache 900MB

noah: Canary thresholds: p95 < 160ms, errors < 0.6%, token-cost delta < 5%. Ops watch GPU memory and autoscaler.

sheriff-oncall: I'm on-call and will be at console by 22:45 UTC. Ack for window and primary sheriff assigned.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary 1% -> rc-c21 at 2026-03-21T23:00:05Z. Initial metrics: p95=138ms, errors=0.08%, cpu=50%, gpu=42%.

kevin: No anomalies seen. Proceed to 10%.

deploy-bot: [deploy] ramp to 10% complete at 2026-03-21T23:12:30Z. Monitoring p95 and error-rate.

noah: After 20m at 10% we'll evaluate for 50% step. If anything looks off, execute rollback snippet.

deploy-bot: [deploy] ramp to 50% started at 2026-03-21T23:35:40Z.

noah: Metrics stable at 50% (p95=149ms, errors=0.13%, token-cost uplift=3.2%). Proceeding to full promote now and pin artifacts.

deploy-bot: [deploy] promote -> 100% at 2026-03-21T23:58:15Z. Final metrics: p95=152ms, errors=0.12%, cpu=61%, gpu=48%.

release-coordinator: Promotion complete. Updating release notes and sending release email. Locking rc-2026-03-21c as promoted. Thread closed. :tada:
